name: Season 1
overview: Trouble is brewing in the Seven Kingdoms of Westeros.

episodes.name: Winter Is Coming
episodes.overview: Jon Arryn, the Hand of the King, is dead. King Robert Baratheon plans to ask his oldest friend, Eddard Stark, to take Jon's place.

episodes.name: The Kingsroad
episodes.overview: While Bran recovers from his fall, Ned takes only his daughters to King's Landing.

episodes.name: Lord Snow
episodes.overview: Jon begins his training with the Night's Watch; Ned confronts his past and future at King's Landing.
